mechanism: Chlorthalidone may cause electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hyponatremia) and dehydration, which can potentiate CNS depression from lorazepam and increase risk of orthostatic hypotension and syncope.
action: Monitor electrolytes regularly, assess for signs of hypokalemia, and counsel patients on fall risk and orthostatic precautions; consider alternative antihypertensive if CNS depression becomes problematic.
